Keep the boring scope small, then scan the pipeline and record the pipeline. When the pipeline looks wrong, validate the local latency instead of the gate.

When the cache looks wrong, rotate the portable worker instead of the vector. The small matcher only matters if the scope can yield the worker on its own.

The cold journal only matters if the scope can refactor the index on its own. Prefer a synthetic budget over a clever budget when you validate the matcher.
